chunks: And from him, from Safwan, from Al-'Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the Imams (peace be upon them both), who said:
"Supplication after the obligatory prayer is superior to supplication after the voluntary prayer, just as the superiority of the obligatory prayer over the voluntary prayer."
ai.seo_question: Which is more meritorious: supplication after obligatory prayer or after voluntary prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* underscores the spiritual potency of the post-obligatory prayer supplication, a practice deeply rooted in Shia tradition as a time when barriers between heaven and earth are lifted. By equating the merit of the du'a to the distinction between fard and nafl prayers, scholars highlight that the divine acceptance is intrinsically linked to the sanctity of the primary act of worship it follows. This establishes a clear jurisprudential priority for believers seeking to maximize their spiritual rewards through consistent adherence to the five daily prayers.
